posts.content_md:
Here's is where I get my pinholes, bargain prices, $26 for your size, they are not mounted, so you would have to remove the old one and put the new one in yourself.

[http://www.edmmicromachining.com/catalog/apertures.html](http://www.edmmicromachining.com/catalog/apertures.html)

But if you need a new mount, well, I don't know what to say!

posts.topic_title: where can I buy a Scie-mechs mounted pinhole?
posts.author: Tom B.
posts.post_subject: where can I buy a Scie-mechs mounted pinhole?
posts.content_md:
Don't know what your mounting requirements are, but this company has a good selection: [http://www.lenoxlaser.com](http://www.lenoxlaser.com)

I bought some blackened pinholes there recently. I think essentially the standard is foil discs at 9.5 mm diameter which

 can be purchased as is or mounted in 16 or 25 mm holders. 

And they sell slits and pinhole apertures for avant-weird retro photography too, which is very cool.
